Name: Polyamory Sweet Morning Routine Fix
Author: TNTpocket
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]

Polyamory Sweet Morning Routine Fix is a standalone SMAPI compatibility patch for Polyamory Sweet Love.

It fixes morning spouse behavior where Stardew Valley may overwrite the location selected by Polyamory Sweet, remove the sleeping pose, leave spouses stuck in bed, or fail to connect them cleanly to their daily schedule.

The mod preserves PSL's selected morning location, restores the native sleeping pose for bed spouses, wakes spouses normally on home days, and reconnects scheduled spouses to their original route.

No Polyamory Sweet files are included or redistributed.


[heading]Installation[/heading]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install Polyamory Sweet Love and its required dependencies.
3. Extract this mod into:

Stardew Valley/Mods


[heading]Main features[/heading]

[list]
[*]Preserves PSL-selected bed, kitchen, patio, and home positions.[/*]
[*]Restores the native sleeping pose for spouses placed in bed.[/*]
[*]Prevents marriageDuties() from permanently overwriting PSL's morning placement.[/*]
[*]Wakes bed spouses at 7:00 on days without an external schedule.[/*]
[*]Reconnects scheduled spouses to their original daily route.[/*]
[*]Supports multiple spouses.[/*]
[*]Does not modify save data.[/*]
[/list]

[heading]Requirements[/heading]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Polyamory Sweet Love[/*]
[/list]

[heading]Tested with[/heading]

[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2[/*]
[*]Polyamory Sweet Love 1.6.1[/*]
[*]Multiple spouses[/*]
[*]Bed, kitchen, and patio placements[/*]
[*]Home days and scheduled days[/*]
[/list]

[heading]Credits[/heading]

Polyamory Sweet Love was created by ApryllForever.

This patch is published with the original author's permission.
